## Change and evidence contract
- [ ] State the user-facing behavior changed, and the files/routes affected.
- [ ] Preserve the paper-first design, mobile readability, focus visibility, and existing research tools.
- [ ] Distinguish original findings, internal exact checks, conditional proofs, and independent review.
- [ ] Link primary source artifacts, credit contributors, and state assumptions / limitations.
- [ ] Confirm the branch includes current `main`; reconcile parallel work before merge.
- [ ] Record relevant static, browser, and exact verifier checks (or explain unrun checks).
- [ ] Include the PR/commit SHA and any publication-approval requirements.

## Test receipts
- Static link / sitemap / provenance checks:
- Browser / narrow-phone evidence:
- Exact research tool / certificate checks:
- Known limitations and follow-up:

> Never promote proof or novelty status solely because CI passes.
